# xz / fuzz_encode_stream

xz's own fuzz target `fuzz_encode_stream` ([source](source/fuzz_encode_stream.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over xz 5.8.2 (tukaani-project/xz at 3d078b52).

Checks 3 properties (listed below); the first, an API contract: lzma_code() driven to completion on the .xz stream ENCODER (LZMA2, CRC64, preset chosen by input[0]) never returns LZMA_PROG_ERROR (liblzma's "API misuse / internal inconsistency" code) for any input; every other return code, including data and memory-limit errors, is accepted.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against xz 5.8.2 at commit 3d078b52.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- lzma_lzma_preset() succeeds for the five fixed presets the first byte selects (0, 1, 5, 0|EXTREME, 3|EXTREME): trivially true for constant valid presets ([lines 55-58](source/fuzz_encode_stream.c#L55-L58)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch xz` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_encode_stream.plain` | 134,752 | `932c489ebc954ee38090decae6a1ef334aaec34fd6e19c14c8e5f48a15704bcf` |
| ubsan | `fuzz_encode_stream.ubsan` | 151,424 | `89ceb2e84e9425511f27807e1c70b33007f1b05dc987443bb894103bc5006917` |
| asan | `fuzz_encode_stream.asan` | 760,216 | `2510107d6faaebf1b1c28c302a1430abcab759d31b9a101a849a00a1116904be` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz_encode_stream.asan-ubsan` | 774,680 | `d13a81d15bc3b664706097d545dd8b5f62b333ff8d33585dd5ce9d126eacf47a` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
